name: Beskid Learn
postCreateCommand: cd /workspaces/beskid && corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.14.0 --activate && (cd compiler && cargo build -p beskid_cli --release) && (BESKID_RUNTIME_PREFIX="/workspaces/beskid/compiler/target/native-runtime-kit" BESKID_RUNTIME_KIT_PROFILE=debug BESKID_CLI_BIN=/workspaces/beskid/compiler/target/release/beskid ./compiler/scripts/stage-native-runtime-kit.sh) && (cd site/learn && pnpm install)
postAttachCommand:
printf 'Ready to start!
Use: cd /workspaces/beskid && just learn-server (local check API) or pnpm run dev in site/learn.
If run checks still fail, stage the runtime kit with: BESKID_RUNTIME_PREFIX=/workspaces/beskid/compiler/target/native-runtime-kit BESKID_RUNTIME_KIT_PROFILE=debug BESKID_CLI_BIN=/workspaces/beskid/compiler/target/release/beskid ./compiler/scripts/stage-native-runtime-kit.sh
'
